## v0.11.0

### Features

- **Themes:** Expanded theme catalog with popular community themes plus new Vireo originals. The theme picker now groups themes and shows live previews. (`e23feff`)
- **Commit graph:** Commit table columns are aligned and headers stay sticky while scrolling. (`3f4883c`)
- **Shortcuts page:** Redesigned shortcut groups with search and responsive columns. (`3f4883c`)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Cosmos-0118/vireo/compare/v0.10.0...v0.11.0
